> Speeder Bikes can become an all-important strategy in any major ground deck, such as [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire{{!}}Ralltiir Operations]], Operatives, or even just straight up [[Tatooine]] ground power. OF course amongst the trees of [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]], they are almost invaluable. Unless your opponent is prepared, just save enough Force and you'll never have to worry about getting jumped by your opponent again, since you'll be able to easily react to wherever your opponent is fighting you at. Beware [[Sense]], an old-tech react stopper, and [[Corporal Beezer]], a new-tech one! Don't forget your Biker Scout - he will get a bike out of your Reserve Deck every turn!.
